content.comment_body: Hello, I am unable to get the [product_name] to function properly in Excel 2019. It works as expected with Excel 2013, but produces a runtime error 76, indicating a missing path, in the newer version. The add-in I am using is at [version_no]. Is there a solution available for this issue? Thank you.
Hello [user_name], Based on my experience, [product_name] is only compatible with Excel 2007, 2010, and 2013, both 32-bit and 64-bit editions. Best regards, [user_name]
As far as I know, [company_name] has tested compatibility with those Excel versions. My suggestion is to submit a Support Request.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced a runtime error when using [product_name] in Excel 2019, although it works correctly in Excel 2013. Other users confirmed the add-in is officially supported only on older Excel versions. There is no workaround mentioned, and incompatibility with newer Excel releases appears to be a known constraint.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated that [product_name] would work without issues on Excel 2019, as it does on Excel 2013.
